question: How tall and how heavy is one section of a bridge tower leg?
answer: The two legs of each Messina Strait bridge tower are stacked from 44 prefabricated sections. Each section is up to 20 meters tall and weighs 1,200 tons. The crane lifts a whole section at a time.
move: One tower section: up to 20 m tall, 1,200 tons; 44 of them make the legs.

web.label: A bridge tower half built on the far shore of the Strait of Messina, its two legs stacked from steel sections, and in front a barge bringing the next section, 20 m tall, a worker beside it for scale. Holding a button makes the crane take its weight, 1,200 t, and lift it onto a leg.

source: Geopop, “Come sarà il Ponte sullo stretto di Messina? La ricostruzione 3D dai progetti originali” (YouTube, 2023)
